message: The one-way-door list covers the fee component folder but not the files that hold the fee rate and the charge payload, so money-moving changes can merge on agent-review approval alone.

CODEOWNERS owns tsys.service.js and session.service.js as single files, so their sibling specs (tsys.service.spec.js, session.service.spec.js) have no owner and get no one-way-door label. CLAUDE.md says a test next to card, bank or TSYS code is a one-way door too, so the two guardrail sources disagree and an agent can rewrite those specs without human review.

The CLAUDE.md guardrail list leaves out .eslintrc*, which CODEOWNERS owns, even though both files say they must stay in sync. Agents read CLAUDE.md to decide the stricter flow, so the lists drifting on day one weakens that promise.
